page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Main title block centred in the upper half; a horizontal rule; a centred block of two lines with a name and degree; a rule; a woodcut or ornament panel in the middle; the printer's imprint in small type at the foot. Faint mirrored lines near the top and centre are show-through from the verso and are not transcribed.
page.notes: The main title block (upper half, large capitals) is printed in a very faint, partly mirrored state. Its words appear to be "PHILOSOPHIA NATURALIS", "REFORMATA", "ID EST, PHILOSOPHIA ARISTOTELICA", "ACCURATA EXAMINATA", "AC SOLIDA CONFIRMATA", "ET NOVA AC VERIORIS INTRODUCTIO", but the mirror-image show-through makes them unreliable, so they are not transcribed as printed text. A round library stamp at the left is excluded. The imprint line and the year at the foot are too faint to read with confidence. The woodcut panel in the centre has no legible text.
